title: Ida inspects the bridge
topic: An engineer named Ida inspects an old road bridge, finds a crack in the concrete and explains the delay to waiting drivers
tail_E: Under the peeling paint the old iron bolts are red with
target_note: 'rust' is the natural completion of 'old iron bolts are red with' in a bridge-inspection context (steel beams, concrete, crack); the word does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Rost'. ' rust' is a single Pythia token (id 20035).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, family F05 (engineer Ida / bridge)
notes: Ten units: Ida inspects the bridge; she walks across it; the steel beams carry trucks; a worker lowers a camera; the screen shows a crack; Ida measures it; cars wait at the barrier; a driver asks; the engineer explains; the inspection ends. Subjects alternate between the protagonist (Ida / she / the engineer), other people (a worker, a driver) and plural objects (the steel beams, the cars), so that C3 switches cross singular and plural subject-verb agreement. No German separable verbs are used; every German adjunct sits after the object in the middle field, which is the unmarked position for a single time/place/manner adjunct. Present tense and positive polarity throughout.
